:::{#exm-negate-quantifiers}
#### Negating "every integer is even"
<!-- no-figure: a rewording of one sentence; nothing to plot -->

Let $S$ be the [integers](number-systems.qmd#def-integers),
and let $P(x)$ be "$x$ is [even](number-systems.qmd#def-even-odd)".
By the first of [De Morgan's laws for quantifiers](#thm-negate-quantifiers),
the negation of "every [integer](number-systems.qmd#def-integers) is even"
is "some integer is not even".
The second law says that the negation of "some integer is even"
is "no integer is even".

:::
